mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_profile (member_no, birth_date, region_code, income, employ_status, major, household_size, education, mrg_stts_cd) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{birthDate}, #{regionCode}, #{income}, #{employStatus}, #{major}, #{householdSize}, #{education}, #{mrgSttsCd})
mapper.update: UPDATE member_profile SET birth_date = #{birthDate}, region_code = #{regionCode}, income = #{income}, employ_status = #{employStatus}, major = #{major}, household_size = #{householdSize}, education = #{education}, mrg_stts_cd = #{mrgSttsCd}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: SELECT member_no, birth_date, region_code, income, employ_status, major, household_size, education, mrg_stts_cd, profile_img_path, updated_at FROM member_profile WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
